#2.0.0 Update Details
 
Agents,
 
It is time to unveil the full contents of Marvel Future Fight 2.0.0.
 
▣ World Boss Mission
 
 For the best possible gaming experience, the new World Boss mode has been added.
 

 * Co-op Mission is currently under construction.

 You will need a team of 8 Characters consisting of 3 Main Attackers and 5 Strikers to enter!
  [Strikers?] They will assist you in multiple ways during the battle! 

Screenshot was taken during the test build, Real build will vary.

 
You will be rewarded if you succeed in defeating the World Boss within the time limit!
 * Play Count will not be consumed if you fail to defeat the boss.
 * If you fail, you will not be rewarded.
 
 * You will not be able to gain experience points in World Boss Mode
 * Auto Play and Continue is not available in World Boss Mission
 * VIP Feature "Tag Healing" is disabled during this mode.
    
▣ Real Time Timeline Battle
 
 1. You will be able to fight in real time against other agents in Timeline Battle
 
* Search Again function has been removed
* Use Find Opponent button to start real time battle!
 
 2. Weekly Participation Reward Added
 Participation rewards for Timeline Battle has been added
 

 
 3. Timeline Battle History Tab Added
 With this tab, you will be able to see who has been the number one Agent amongst all the agents within the last 3 weeks.
 
▣ Comic Cards Added
 
 Cover Collection feature has been changed into comic cards.
 By equipping Comic Cards, you will gain all the stats the card has across all your teams.
 Cards can also be obtained via Dimension Rifts.
 

  1. Upgrade: Upgrade your card to get a Higher Rank Card!
  2. Sell: You can sell cards with this button
  3. Equip: You can equip cards with this button
    * Total of 5 Cards can be equipped at the same time
    * 2 identical cards cannot be equipped at the same time
    * If you try to unequip a card from the card slot, you will need to pay crystals
    * If you have no extra inventory slots, cards cannot be unequipped
    * If you are trying to equip cards in a slot that is already in use, the previous card will be discarded
 
▣ 3 New Characters
 
 Proxima Midnight, Black Dwarf, and Corvus Glaive join Marvel Future Fight!
 
  
  * These characters are only obtainable via the World Boss Mode.
 
Due to the new Characters, new achievements and new team bonuses have been added.
 
▶ Leveling system Differences
 
 Unlike previous characters, World Boss Characters have to be leveled up in a different way.
 If a character requires this new system to level up, they will have different frame around their portrait.
 

 
 1. Level Up: Select the character that you want to level up, and press level up button. Next, select the biometrics that you want to use to level up




 2. Rank Up: Select the character that you want to rank up, and press Rank Up button
 * The Character must already be at their current max Level in order to Rank Up
 

 Based on character’s rank, amount and type of Black Anti-Matter will change.
 Black Anti-Matter can be ranked up by Material Fusion
  * Black Anti-Matter can be obtained from World Boss and/or Material Fusion
 
 [How to fuse Black Anti-Matter]
   1. Tap the Black Anti-Matter Icon


 
 2. Press [Material Fusion] Button
 

 
 3. If you have enough material to fuse, with certain amount of gold you can get the next rank of Black Anti-Matter


 
▣ 3 New Uniforms
 
 Uniforms for Destroyer, Hulkbuster(Iron Man Mark 43), and Elsa Bloodstone have been added.
 
* You will be able to check new uniforms in Marvel Universe and the Uniform Tab.
* New uniforms will be available for a discounted price during a certain period.
 
▣ New 6★ Skill
 
 Destroyer now has a 6★ skill.
 
 
 
- Destroyer(include Uniform): Asgardian Armament
 
▣ ISO-8 Awakening
 
 You can now awaken 6★+5 ISO-8’s. Awakening will cost another 6★ ISO-8 and Gold.
 
 * Awaken is only available for +5 6★ ISO-8. You can awaken up to 6 times.
 * Awakened ISO-8 cannot be upgraded.
 
 * Awakening needs 6★ +5 ISO-8 and certain amount of Gold
 * Material ISO-8 will be consumed in this process
 * Based on awakened rank, the number of required ISO-8's to awaken changes.
 
 Alternative ISO-8 slots have been added. Here you can equip different ISO-8 sets to use in different modes!


 * 2nd, and 3rd slot needs a certain amount of crystals to unlock.
 * Only one set of ISO-8 will be applied even if the 2nd and 3rd slots are already opened
 
▣ Special Gear Improvement
 
 1. Upgrade Special Gear
   You can upgrade Special Gear using other special gear.

 2. You can unequip Special Gear by using a certain amount of Crystals.


 * Special Gear can be upgrade to +2
 
▣ Hero Ability

* Based on their personal feature, each Character has their unique Ability
* These Abilities gives extra stat bonuses


 
▣ Story Biometric Limit Increased

Due to the new characters requiring Biometrics to level up, we have increased the limit of daily Biometrics from a stage. You can now receive, up to 5 Biometrics per stage.
 
▣ Other Improvement

 1. Time left for Next Free Draw of Hero Chest will show up
 2. Best reward gauge will be filled up based on your rank in Team-Up Play.
 3. Team-Up Play now gives different rewards based on your final damage rank
 4. Fixed an issue with Destroyer’s skill “Disintegration Beam”, “Crush”, and “Obliteration Wave“ not hitting correctly.
 5. Lash’s skill(including Uniform) “Disintegrate” now cut’s enemies defense down. This effect can stack.
 6. Fixed an issue with Rocket Raccoon’s skill “Covering Fire” and “Trip Mine” not having any skill cooldown time.
 7. Fixed an issue with Spider-Man(Miles Morales)’s skill “Back Bite” not having any skill cooldown time.
 8. Fixed an issue with Hawkeye(include Uniform)’s skill “Sure Shot” and “Evasive Shot” not having any skill cooldown time.
 9. Fixed an issue with S.H.I.E.L.D. Lab where Jemma Simmons did not appear.
10. Destroyer(including Uniform)’s Passive Skill “Odin’s Enchantment” has been changed to +50% decrease to received Energy Damage
11. If your S.H.I.E.L.D. level is less than 10, you will face a Hero Guide Quest that can rank up your selected character to rank 6.
12. You can rotate your Characters in My Team Menu when you hide the Team List.
13. You can earn other Character’s Biometrics in Alliance Battle, and the point system has been restructured.
14. VIP 7 Reward in Team-Up Play has been changed from Special Gear to Gear Up Kit.
15. Returning User Rewards have been updated, and are now the same as the New User Rewards.
